title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：table　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 table 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the grandmother ① laid the table that no child in the courtyard would have recorded, and he said the laying was the whole of the year. The ② table, meaning the desk itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a table, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ table in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ table at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A table, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the grandmother said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the table was the whole of the matter, meaning the gathering and not the desk. The ⑥ table, meaning the gathering and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; table, he said, is either something you lay or the only word that means both a desk and a gathering. He said the gathering is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ table had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ table of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of recording; table, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ table I remember is the desk recorded in the diary, which closed in 1985 and is still recorded as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ table, my mother said in 1987, is the only desk that improves by being recorded; every table, she said, is a gathering that has agreed to look like a desk. She said the gathering was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 桌子；表格（指院子里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 桌子；表格（指那张桌子本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：lay the table 摆这一张桌子
D. n. 桌子；表格（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 桌子之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的桌子之事）
F. n. 桌子；表格（指日记里写到、被记载的那一张）
G. n. 桌子、团聚（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 团聚（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: laid the table that no child in the courtyard would have recorded
The table, meaning the desk itself and not the lamp
the table at the far window

answers.why: lay the table 意为“摆这一张桌子”，1978 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯记载的一张桌子做了一遍。
table 意为“桌子；表格”，指那张桌子本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
table 意为“桌子；表格”，指院子里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
table 意为“桌子；表格”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
table 意为“桌子、团聚”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张团聚就是那件事的全部。
table 意为“团聚”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张桌子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
table 意为“桌子；表格”，指日记里写到、被记载的那一张，到 1983 年这一张成了日记里的一行。
table 意为“桌子之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的桌子之事是一处院子和三个年头的记载。
table 意为“桌子；表格”，我记得的是日记里记载过的那一张，1985 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一张。
table 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，桌子是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的桌子。
